title: Learn Prefixes, Suffixes to Expand Your Vocabulary
titleZh: 学习词缀，扩大你的词汇量
credits: Alice Bryant wrote this story for Learning English. George Grow was the editor.

sentences.en: On a recent program, we explained that knowing just a few root words in English can help you understand the meaning of hundreds more words.
sentences.zh: 在最近的一期节目中，我们解释说，只需掌握英语中的几个词根，就能帮助你理解数百个单词的含义。

sentences.en: To refresh your memory, a root word is the simplest form of a word.
sentences.zh: 为了帮你回忆一下，词根是一个单词最简单的形式。

sentences.en: For example, two forms of the root for the word “see” are vis- and vid- such as in the words "television" and "video."
sentences.zh: 例如，"see"这个词的词根有两种形式：vis-和vid-，比如"television"和"video"这两个词。

sentences.en: Today, we will tell you about prefixes and suffixes – groups of letters that appear at the beginnings and endings of words.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们要介绍的是前缀和后缀——出现在单词开头和结尾的字母组合。

sentences.en: Learning the meanings of common prefixes and suffixes can help you understand unknown English words you come across.
sentences.zh: 学习常见前缀和后缀的含义，能帮助你理解遇到的陌生英语单词。

sentences.en: It can also help you become better at spelling words.
sentences.zh: 它还能帮助你更好地拼写单词。

sentences.en: Let's start with prefixes.
sentences.zh: 让我们从前缀开始。

sentences.en: A prefix is a letter or a group of letters that we add to the beginning of a word.
sentences.zh: 前缀是我们添加到单词开头的字母或字母组合。

sentences.en: Prefixes change the meanings of words.
sentences.zh: 前缀会改变单词的含义。

sentences.en: For example, the prefix un- (or u-n) can mean "not," "remove," or "opposite."
sentences.zh: 例如，前缀un-（或u-n）可以表示"不"、"去除"或"相反"。

sentences.en: Adding un- to the word "happy" gives you the word "unhappy," which means not happy.
sentences.zh: 在"happy"这个词前加上un-，就得到了"unhappy"这个词，意思是"不开心"。

sentences.en: U-n and r-e (or re-) are the two most common prefixes in the English language.
sentences.zh: u-n和r-e（或re-）是英语中最常见的两个前缀。

sentences.en: Re- means "again" or "back," such as in the words "rethink" "redo" and "repay."
sentences.zh: re-表示"再"或"回"，比如"rethink"、"redo"和"repay"这些词。

sentences.zh: 以下是学习前缀时需要注意的几点：

sentences.en: Now, let's turn to suffixes.
sentences.zh: 现在，让我们转向后缀。

sentences.en: A suffix is a letter or group of letters added to the end of a word.
sentences.zh: 后缀是添加到单词结尾的字母或字母组合。

sentences.en: Suffixes are commonly used to show the part of speech of a word.
sentences.zh: 后缀常用于表示单词的词性。

sentences.en: For example, adding "ion" to the verb "act" gives us "action," the noun form of the word.
sentences.zh: 例如，在动词"act"后加上"ion"，就得到了"action"，即这个词的名词形式。

sentences.en: Suffixes also tell us the verb tense of words or whether the words are plural or singular.
sentences.zh: 后缀还能告诉我们单词的动词时态，或单词是复数还是单数。

sentences.en: ​Some common suffixes are -er, -s, -es, -ed, -ing and -ly.
sentences.zh: 一些常见的后缀有-er、-s、-es、-ed、-ing和-ly。

sentences.en: Here are a few things to remember when learning suffixes:
sentences.zh: 学习后缀时，有几件事需要记住：

sentences.en: There are additional suffix rules, but they deal with spelling and can be learned with time and practice.
sentences.zh: 还有额外的后缀规则，但它们涉及拼写，可以随着时间和练习来掌握。

sentences.en: A thing to keep in mind about both prefixes and suffixes is that some are only used with some words.
sentences.zh: 关于前缀和后缀，有一件事需要记住，那就是有些前缀和后缀只用于某些单词。

sentences.en: For example, we add the suffix -ful to some nouns to mean "full of," such as in the words "beautiful" or "helpful."
sentences.zh: 例如，我们会给某些名词加上后缀 -ful，表示"充满……的"，比如单词"beautiful"或"helpful"。

sentences.en: But, we cannot add -ful to just any noun.
sentences.zh: 但是，我们不能给任何名词都加上 -ful。

sentences.en: You could not, for example, say "loveful" to mean full of love.
sentences.zh: 例如，你就不能说"loveful"来表示充满爱。

sentences.en: So, what are some ways that you can practice common prefixes and suffixes?
sentences.zh: 那么，有哪些方法可以练习常见的前缀和后缀呢？

sentences.en: One way is to use online flashcards from websites like Quizlet.
sentences.zh: 一种方法是使用像Quizlet这样的网站上的在线抽认卡。

sentences.en: You can choose sets of cards that are already made or create and use your own sets.
sentences.zh: 你可以选择已经制作好的卡片集，也可以创建并使用自己的卡片集。

sentences.en: Or, you can make your own flashcards with pieces of paper.
sentences.zh: 或者，你可以用纸条制作自己的抽认卡。

sentences.en: Once you've spent time practicing, take a news story or page in a book and look for words that have the prefixes and suffixes you learned.
sentences.zh: 一旦你花时间进行了练习，就可以找一篇新闻报道或书中的一页，寻找带有你学过的前缀和后缀的单词。

sentences.en: Then, use what you know about the meaning of the root words to guess the meanings of those words.
sentences.zh: 然后，运用你对词根含义的了解来推测这些单词的含义。

sentences.en: Learning prefixes and suffixes will not only build your vocabulary but can make unfamiliar English words a lot less frightening.
sentences.zh: 学习前缀和后缀不仅能扩充你的词汇量，还能让陌生的英语单词变得不那么可怕。
